participant_1.name: Emma
participant_1.personality: Creative and nurturing, I enjoy expressing myself through baking and knitting. I often ponder about life's fragility.
participant_1.background: Knitting is my passion. I am scared of dying. The county wide bake sale is where I feel most at home. I love to bake cookies.

participant_2.name: Terren
participant_2.personality: Practical and charitable, I find fulfillment in my work and helping others. I have a strong connection to my roots and value community service.
participant_2.background: I work fulltime in a shipyard. I donate a part of my salary to charity each month. I volunteer my time with a local bunny rescue. My favorite color is navy blue.
